# crosswork_static_route (Data Source)

This data source can read a static route of the zero touch provisioning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_static_route" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Address of the route
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the route
